feeds.title: Financial Times » Chinese economy
feeds.description: Read news, analysis, and commentary on the Chinese economy from the Financial Times. Our in-depth coverage keeps you informed on what's happening. The Financial Times is one of the world's leading news organizations, recognized internationally for its authority, integrity, and accuracy.

feeds.title: The Economist » China
feeds.description: Discover the latest news and stories about the economy, political affairs, foreign policy, and more from China from The Economist. The Economist Group is a staunchly independent global media and information services company with intelligent brands for an international audience.

feeds.title: George Magnus » China
feeds.description: Read George Magnus's views on the latest developments related to China, It's economic and foreign policy, and more. George Magnus is an independent economist and commentator, an Associate at the China Centre, Oxford University, and an adviser to some asset management companies.

feeds.title: ECIPE » Far-East
feeds.description: European Centre for International Political Economy's research articles on the Far-east, especially China dive into the economic and global aspects of regional upheavals and policy changes. The European Centre for International Political Economy (ECIPE) is an independent and non-profit policy research think tank dedicated to trade policy.

feeds.title: Atlantic Council » China
feeds.description: Stay up to date on China's Economic Policy, Domestic Politics, and Geo-political challenges in this section of our blog. The Atlantic Council is a nonpartisan organization that galvanizes US leadership and engagement in the world, in partnership with allies and partners, to shape solutions to global challenges.

feeds.title: Andrew Batson » Economics
feeds.description: Andrew Batson's blog features his musings on China, Economics, along with books, economics, jazz, history, and other stuff of interest. Andrew is the China research director for Gavekal Dragonomics, an independent economic research firm. He writes and talks about the Chinese economy, and manages a team of analysts for his company.

feeds.title: China Economic Review
feeds.description: Helping our international readers understand China's changing economic terrain, China Economic Review (CER) has been a dependably independent voice on trends and developments in the greater Chinese economy for a quarter-century. Our coverage is widely read by economists, business leaders, academics, and students with an interest in one of the world's most vibrant and complex developing markets.

feeds.title: Ecoscope Blog » China
feeds.description: Read all our posts about China's Economic conditions, recent policy changes, and its global impact in the Ecoscope blog. The ecoscope blog aims to increase dialogue on topical economic issues beyond the usual OECD audiences. We are economists writing on their current field of research and reach out to other experts across the world to generate discussion on an array of economic issues.

feeds.title: CKGSB Knowledge » Economics and Finance
feeds.description: Explore news stories, opinions, analyses, and interviews about China's Economics and how it affects the global economic situation. CKGSB is a private, research-intensive, and independent business school in China and produces and leads in original research and insights on doing business in and with China.

feeds.title: CSIS » Chinese Business and Economics
feeds.description: Find articles focusing on and providing unmatched thought leadership by examining the hidden dynamics of China's economy and its implications for industries and other countries. The Center for Strategic and International Studies (CSIS) is a bipartisan, nonprofit policy research organization dedicated to advancing practical ideas to address the world's greatest challenges.
